instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium full shot. On a paved park path next to a metal fence, the bald man in the olive t-shirt (R2) and the man in the white t-shirt (R1) walk side-by-side. The bald man (R2) on the left smiles at his partner, holding his hand and resting his other hand on the partner's arm. The man in the white t-shirt (R1) on the right walks forward, smiling back. Warm afternoon sunlight filters through the trees behind them, creating a soft backlight.

R2 rests his other hand on R1's arm
R1 walks forward and smiles back at R2
R2 smiles at R1 while maintaining hand and arm contact
